title: specanchor ledger-term v1
description: One glossary entry per term, per bounded context. aliases_in_code and not_to_be_confused_with are what make the glossary usable by an agent — without them it is decoration.

definition.description: Two sentences maximum; structured fields carry the rest.

aliases_in_code.description: Identifiers as they appear in source. Feeds the statement-quality gate.

not_to_be_confused_with.description: Cross-context collisions: same word, different concept, different context.
